name: Scheme for Purchase of 4 Wheeler for Own Use
benefit: **Loan Limit:** Upto 75% of the cost of vehicle. **Interest Concession:** 1% for Good Borrowers of ‘A’ category and 0.5% for ‘B’ category.
_eligibility_text: The scheme is applicable to Qualified Personnel in Medicine, Management, Accountancy, Engineering, Architecture, etc. and Good Borrowers of the Corporation (Industrial Units).
